newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat turns lower on soybean/wheat spreads.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat turns lower on soybean/wheat spreads.

text.p: CBOT wheat futures turned lower early Friday in response to soybean/wheat spread trade, floor traders said.
Sharp gains in soybeans over the past several days has made that trade attractive, traders said.

Support in the market was expected to come from concerns about slow harvesting in the U.S. southern Plains and on persistent talk about dry weather in portions of the U.S. spring wheat growing region, traders said.
In early trade, Paine Webber and Dean Witter each sold 500,000 bushels July and LIT bought 500,000 July, traders said.
